summary: Frontend-only testing of this round's 2 new features: (1) sortable scanner table column headers, (2) all-symbol WS subscription for live price ticking. Both PASSED via live browser automation against the deployed preview URL with real login (daniel.r.millner@gmail.com) + Demo Mode. Verified via actual displayed cell values (not just DOM diffing) that clicking each of the 6 headers (Sym/Price/Chg%/RVol/Float/5-5) correctly re-sorts rows: Price desc (MARA 17.41 > RIOT 12.45 > NIO 9.99 > PLUG 5.08 > LCID 3.52), Price re-click asc (reversed), Chg% desc (NIO 13.5% > MARA 11.6% > RIOT 10.1% > LCID 10.0% > PLUG 5.8%), RVol desc (NIO 8.0x > RIOT 7.7x > LCID 5.8x > MARA 5.3x > PLUG 3.3x), Float asc (PLUG 11.1M < RIOT 11.2M < NIO 13.7M < LCID 13.8M < MARA 16.9M), Sym asc (LCID/MARA/NIO/PLUG/RIOT alphabetical) - all correct. Chevron icon confirmed present (1 svg) on the active header and a neutral icon (1 svg, ChevronsUpDown) on inactive headers. Clicking a row to select it still works correctly after multiple sort operations (clicked LCID row post-sort, selected-symbol-header correctly showed 'LCID', chart/QuickTradePanel/news all populated). Live WS wiring: captured the actual outgoing WS frame on wss://.../api/ws/market-data and confirmed it contains {"action":"subscribe","symbols":["RIOT","RIVN","PLUG","MARA"]} - ALL 4 visible scanner symbols, not just the selected one - immediately after a scan completed. No console errors from the new subscribe-all-symbols effect. Regression: sort order (Price desc) correctly persisted/re-applied across a live scan-refresh cycle (new symbols PLTR/MARA/NIO/LCID re-appeared still in descending price order automatically). '5/5 Ready to Trade' chip panel correctly reflected live prices matching the table rows in every screenshot taken. Full 7-tab nav regression (Dashboard/Scan/Trade/History/Missed/Settings/Demo) completed with ZERO console errors. Re-login flow works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: ScannerTable.js sort implementation is clean: static ALIGN_CLASS map correctly avoids dynamic Tailwind class interpolation, COLUMNS config with defaultDir per metric is a good pattern, stable Array.prototype.sort preserves secondary ordering for ties correctly.

Dashboard.js withLivePrices() correctly recomputes pct_change from prev_close rather than trusting a stale field, and the new all-symbols subscribe effect is properly scoped to `results` changes with subscribe() being idempotent/additive as documented - no risk of subscribe spam or duplicate listeners observed.

Minor note (not a bug): could not directly test a chip click in ReadyToTradePanel this round because Demo Mode randomly produced 0 ready_to_trade candidates on that particular scan tick - not reproducible on demand, but panel content/prices were visually confirmed correct and in sync with the table across multiple other scan snapshots during this session.
